slides.texte_overlay:
How to become the man
people respect without trying
Do what you say you'll do. If you said Friday, it's done on Friday. People respect reliability more than talent, charm or confidence.
Treat everyone the same way. The waiter, the cleaner, the boss, the stranger. People watch how you treat those who can't do anything for you.
Stay calm when others lose it. In an argument, a crisis, a traffic jam. The calmest man in the room is usually the one everyone listens to.
Don't talk badly about people who aren't there. Anyone who gossips with you will gossip about you. Discretion makes people trust you completely.
Before: I had nothing to add when people talked about real topics. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and now I join in.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I had nothing to add when people talked about real topics. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Now I join in.

slides.texte_overlay: Take care of your appearance. Clean clothes that fit, a fresh haircut, good posture. It shows you respect yourself, so others naturally do too.
Own your mistakes out loud. "That was my fault, I'll fix it." A man who takes responsibility earns more respect than a man who's never wrong.
